evidence_boundary: Offline matrix and contract coverage only. This file does not prove runtime Android or macOS acceptance and cannot close the README Phase 1 actionable-errors gate without retained device evidence for every supported state.

states.system_state: USB client cannot reach the Mac app before display configuration or after ECONNREFUSED.
states.source_classifier: ConnectionGuidanceFactory.hostNotRunning from pre-display rejection or closed protocol probe
states.user_visible_copy: connection_guidance_mac_unavailable_title plus connection_guidance_usb_open_mac_prefix and the active ADB recovery resource
states.user_action: Open Vibe Screen on the Mac, keep the chosen USB debugging transport authorized, use the Mac app's USB repair action if needed, then retry.

states.system_state: USB mode has no usable Android-to-Mac route or ADB reverse mapping.
states.user_visible_copy: connection_guidance_adb_route_unavailable_title plus connection_guidance_usb_route_unavailable_prefix and the active ADB recovery resource
states.user_action: Reconnect or authorize the Android device, use the Mac app's USB repair action, then retry.

states.system_state: Trusted LAN cannot route to the saved Mac address or DNS name.
states.user_visible_copy: connection_guidance_network_unavailable_title plus connection_guidance_lan_network_unavailable_message
states.user_action: Reconnect both devices to the same trusted Wi-Fi, disable VPN or guest isolation, verify the saved Mac address and port, then reconnect.

states.system_state: USB, LAN, or Internet connect attempt times out.
states.source_classifier: ConnectionGuidanceFactory.timeout from SocketTimeoutException or timeout detail
states.user_visible_copy: connection_guidance_timeout_title with USB, LAN, or Internet timeout recovery resource
states.user_action: Confirm the Host is listening on the selected route, check the network or ADB tunnel, and retry with a fresh profile when required.

states.system_state: LAN or Internet QR scan cannot continue because Camera permission is denied or permanently denied.
states.source_classifier: Camera permission request and Settings-return state machine
states.ui_surface: QR scanner permission panel with Open Settings action
states.user_visible_copy: camera_permission_required, camera_permission_settings_instructions, and internet_camera_permission_blocked
states.user_action: Open Android Settings, allow Camera for Vibe Screen, return to the app, and retry the QR scan.

states.system_state: Peer sends incompatible protocol, unknown message, rejected session, invalid display, invalid envelope, invalid frame, invalid media header, or invalid media payload.
states.source_classifier: ConnectionGuidanceFactory maps terminal protocol SessionFailureKind values to INCOMPATIBLE_SESSION
states.user_visible_copy: connection_guidance_mac_incompatible_title and connection_guidance_mac_incompatible_message
states.user_action: Update Vibe Screen on both devices, then reconnect. The raw peer detail is intentionally not shown in user copy.

states.system_state: Outbound input writer reaches true capacity saturation or rejects a non-retryable input failure.
states.user_visible_copy: connection_guidance_input_overloaded_title and connection_guidance_input_overloaded_message
states.user_action: Reconnect, then reduce simultaneous touch or peripheral input.

states.system_state: MediaCodec decoder cannot apply the advertised video configuration or recover a compatible stream.
states.user_visible_copy: connection_guidance_video_decoder_recovery_title and connection_guidance_video_decoder_recovery_message
states.user_action: Keep the Mac app open while the client retries with a compatible codec; if it repeats, gather logs and switch to a known supported codec path before claiming acceptance.

states.system_state: Mac Host intentionally ends the current session.
states.user_visible_copy: connection_guidance_session_ended_title and connection_guidance_mac_ended_session_message
states.user_action: Leave the app disconnected or start a new session from the Mac and reconnect.

states.system_state: Android user taps Disconnect or otherwise intentionally ends the session.
states.user_visible_copy: connection_guidance_session_ended_title and connection_guidance_user_disconnected_message
states.user_action: Use Try Again or the relevant pairing flow when the user wants to reconnect.

states.system_state: Host cannot capture because Screen Recording permission is missing or stale after a rebuild.
states.ui_surface: Host onboarding view and startup alert
states.user_visible_copy: Allow Screen & System Audio Recording / Screen Recording and relaunch Vibe Screen
states.user_action: Grant the installed Vibe Screen app Screen Recording in System Settings, quit, reopen, and rerun the Host preflight.

states.system_state: Touch, keyboard, native pointer, or window migration is requested without Accessibility permission.
states.ui_surface: Host onboarding/settings copy and runtime logs
states.user_visible_copy: Enable input and window control; Accessibility lets tablet gestures control the Mac and lets Vibe Screen move and restore windows.
states.user_action: Grant Accessibility to the stable signed installed app, quit and reopen Vibe Screen, then retry input or window movement.

states.system_state: USB setup cannot find adb, finds no authorized Android device, or finds multiple devices without a selected target.
states.source_classifier: Host ADB setup and device selection diagnostics
states.ui_surface: Host status/settings diagnostics and Android USB guidance
states.user_visible_copy: Install Android Platform Tools, connect and authorize exactly one device, or select the intended endpoint before repairing the USB route.
states.user_action: Authorize the phone, select the intended device in the Mac app, use the USB repair action, then retry.

states.system_state: TCP port 54321 is already bound by another process or a previous Host instance.
states.source_classifier: NWListener .failed state for an occupied port / SingleInstanceProcessLockError.alreadyRunning
states.ui_surface: Host startup alert and troubleshooting runbook
states.user_visible_copy: Quit the conflicting process or choose another port in both Host and client.
states.user_action: Run lsof -nP -iTCP:54321 -sTCP:LISTEN, stop the conflicting listener, then restart Vibe Screen.

states.system_state: ScreenCaptureKit exposes no capturable display, capture stops, or the Mac is headless without a usable physical, dummy, or Screen Sharing display.
states.source_classifier: ScreenCapture setup and terminal capture failure handling
states.ui_surface: Host capture failure alert and runbook
states.user_visible_copy: Unlock the Mac, attach a physical or dummy display, or switch to Current Main Display after granting Screen Recording.
states.user_action: Recheck Screen Recording, attach or select a usable display, relaunch after permission changes, and retry streaming.

states.system_state: Private CGVirtualDisplay APIs are absent, denied, or no longer behave after a macOS update.
states.user_visible_copy: Use Current Mac Display or attach a physical/dummy display when the private virtual-display path is unavailable.
states.user_action: Switch display source to Current Main Display, attach a dummy/physical display if needed, then rerun the relevant display acceptance gate.

states.system_state: A client-selected physical or virtual display is unavailable by the time the Host applies the request.
states.ui_surface: Host logs and Android display-selection pending/rejected UI in PR #272
states.user_visible_copy: Keep the current stream active, reject the stale display selection, and keep the user on the last confirmed display.
states.user_action: Refresh the display list, select an online display, or switch the Host to Current Main Display.

states.system_state: LAN mode has no usable trusted-network address, firewall allowance, or current QR pairing route.
states.source_classifier: WirelessAuth token/admission diagnostics and trusted-LAN runbook
states.ui_surface: Host LAN settings and Android wireless repair surface
states.user_visible_copy: Use a trusted private Wi-Fi, verify the Mac address and port, allow Vibe Screen through the firewall, and scan a fresh QR if the token changed.
states.user_action: Reconnect both devices to the same trusted Wi-Fi, confirm firewall and address, then pair or reconnect again.

states.system_state: Login startup is requested but the macOS login item or onboarding preconditions are not approved.
states.user_visible_copy: Approve the login item only after onboarding is complete and permissions are stable.
states.user_action: Complete onboarding with a monitor attached, approve the Login Item, log out and back in, then verify the Host listener and Android reconnect evidence.

states.system_state: Internet profile is revoked, expired, rejected, or cannot recover its route.
states.ui_surface: Host Internet settings and Android Internet error surface
states.user_visible_copy: Revoke stale credentials, create or import a fresh session profile, and retry the selected Direct or TURN route.
states.user_action: Use a fresh Host-issued profile and keep failed/revoked Internet states below release status until public-network evidence exists.
